text:
North vs South first-year value:

Cash pre-tax = salary + bonus
After-tax cash = pre-tax * (1 - 0.35)

North:
Salary 155,000 + Bonus 10%*155,000=15,500 = 170,500 pre-tax
After-tax = 170,500 * 0.65 = 110,825
Match = 5%*155,000=7,750 capped at 20,000 => 7,750
Equity vested = 80,000 * 12/48 = 20,000
Total = 110,825 + 7,750 + 20,000 = 138,575

South:
Salary 155,000 + Bonus 0 = 155,000 pre-tax
After-tax = 155,000 * 0.65 = 100,750
Match = 6%*155,000=9,300 capped at 6,000 => 6,000
Equity vested = 80,000 * 12/48 = 20,000
Total = 100,750 + 6,000 + 20,000 = 126,750

138,575 > 126,750, so North is higher.
{"choice": "North", "value": 138575}
